g.text: Database reports provide an estimated range of relationships (e.g. 2nd-3rd cousin), never a definitive family relationship.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Inheritance and recombination are stochastic, and overlapping cM distributions preclude unique pedigree assignment from DNA alone.
